data.name: Pebble For A Queen
data.detailed_description:
Break rocks. Grow stronger. Rise to become King of the Xantul.

Goguz is no king — not yet. But every day, he sets out across a bright, hand-drawn cartoon world with one mission: find the perfect precious stone for his queen. Explore colorful biomes, smash everything in your path, and pour your rewards into a vast web of skill trees. Little by little, Goguz grows — bigger, stronger, until he towers over the world as the true King of the Xantul.

Pebble for a Queen is an exploration adventure with the deep, ever-climbing progression of a true incremental.

☀️ A run a day

Each day is a fresh expedition. Roam vibrant biomes, break rocks, gather resources, and take on whatever stands between you and the perfect stone. When night falls, invest everything you've earned — then wake up stronger and push even further.

🌳 Over 1,500 nodes — and every choice matters

Progression runs deep. Spend five distinct resources across multiple sprawling skill trees, including four dedicated elemental trees. This isn't mindless unlocking: your choices carry real weight. Build smart, specialize with purpose, and a well-planned path will make you far more powerful than a careless one. There's always another node, another milestone, another goal just ahead.

🌀 Master the Elemental Tails

Goguz is no ordinary Xantul. Wield a collection of elemental tails, each with its own flavor and playstyle, and mix and match them to shape how you explore and break your way through the world. Finding the right combination is half the fun.

🎯 Quests that give it all meaning

This is no mindless number-cruncher. A thread of quests and challenges runs through the entire adventure, guiding your journey and giving every step a purpose. Some gate your progress entirely — rise to the challenge and prove yourself before the next tier of upgrades is yours. Every milestone is earned, never handed to you.

👑 Become the King

This is a journey of transformation. As Goguz grows through the adventure, he changes — rising from a humble Xantul to a colossal ruler. The path to becoming king is yours to carve.

🎨 A hand-drawn cartoon world

Bright, bold, and full of character — every creature and every corner is hand-drawn in a classic cartoon style, full of light-hearted charm and a joy to explore.

🏆 The end is only the beginning

Reaching the end of the journey unlocks something more — a hidden challenge for those who want to test everything they've learned. What it asks of you, and what it holds, is yours to discover.

Set in the Sunrohc universe — a growing world of games from Mangus.

  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
